The mother of all zoom lenses and widely considered one of the best pairings with Sony lenses there is! 2x Sony 24-70mm gm lenses.

This rental includes three Sony 24-70mm f/2.8 G Master lenses, one of the most popular and versatile lenses in professional filmmaking and photography.

The 24-70mm GM is known for:
	•	Exceptional sharpness & clarity across the entire zoom range
	•	Fast constant f/2.8 aperture — perfect for low light & cinematic depth of field
	•	Sony G Master glass quality — accurate colors, crisp contrast, and smooth bokeh
	•	Silent autofocus — ideal for video and professional shoots

Having three identical lenses allows for consistent coverage across multi-cam productions, live events, interviews, weddings, commercials, and narrative filmmaking.



⭐️ Included in this rental set ⭐️
	•	3× Sony 24-70mm f/2.8 GM lenses (E-Mount, full frame)
	•	3× Front lens caps
	•	3× Rear caps
	•	3× Lens hoods
	•	Protective pouches

(No batteries or special cables required — fully mechanical lenses.)
